legal_mapping: Victims’ Code – updates & communication (prefers phone vs chat?)
DPA 2018 Part 3 – accuracy of records (NICE links, case chronology)
Protection from Harassment Act 1997 s.4A – stalking causing serious alarm/distress (mentioned)

entries.speaker: PC Dixon
entries.quote: ‎Messages and calls are end-to-end encrypted. Only people in this chat can read, listen to, or share them.

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: No phone calls, you were happy to move my case to july on holiday

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: 17 days, no one from the police contacted me

entries.speaker: PC Dixon
entries.quote: Hi Ben. Not sure what you mean by July? I said the case file was being built, I just required the medical letter and additional contact evidence, which I sent the NICE links for. You said you would speak to your GP and get the letter. Then the file would be sent for review before CPS

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: You stated it was always from november

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: And still asked for the lost call in july

entries.speaker: PC Dixon
entries.quote: Yep if you still have the phone call from July it would help the case

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: Whys the rape not perverting the course of justice

entries.speaker: PC Dixon
entries.quote: CPS look at the entire relationship history, and any evidence you have is disclosed to them, it is up to them if they use it or not

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: You told me i shouldnt have looked on her instagram

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: When did you tell me that

entries.speaker: PC Dixon
entries.quote: Until the case is reassigned I will continue to finalise the case file. What you do or don't do in regard to Instagram is your choice, you are an adult. If you wish to speak properly rather than chatting on here we can arrange to do so

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: No you told me you’d already said in light of my suicide i shouldnt have gone on hers in the first place

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: An officer that tells someone off hearing their voice after taking their life that has resorted to their own safeguarding

entries.speaker: PC Dixon
entries.quote: I said that going on her Instagram would not help you mental health, and has no bearing on the case against her. If anything it would evidence stalking type behaviour from you towards her

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: The pattern now is no reply

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: Mental health was never my case

entries.speaker: PC Dixon
entries.quote: Yes a further statement was done with you and we are awaiting the medical letter.

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: You asked me to go on her instagram

entries.speaker: PC Dixon
entries.quote: You said you had previously gone on her Instagram, I said that you could mention this in a statement as it's something that's already happened. I said that you should avoid looking at her Instagram in the future if it is affecting you, I didnt ask you to go on her Instagram again

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: Providing 2 nice links, that date back to when we met?

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: But how would i collect evidence?

entries.speaker: PC Dixon
entries.quote: I sent you more links after the phone call. I asked you to provide the medical letter from your GP, that would evidence the S4a offence

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: When did you tell me not to then

entries.speaker: PC Dixon
entries.quote: And any communications that you don't think you have already sent to us

entries.speaker: PC Dixon
entries.quote: Other links have been sent to you by myself and a previous officer which have not been replied to

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: Ok thats all i need thankyou

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: As this is now confirmed, by yourself included (not saying what)

entries.speaker: PC Dixon
entries.quote: Have you obtained the medical letter?

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: I dont want this case you’ve dealt with

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: Have you logged my suicide and gone in holiday with all your senior officer back today

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: I called 999 and said police plaease

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: I dont want you anywhere near my case

entries.speaker: PC Dixon
entries.quote: Unless you provide the evidence as I have asked multiple times now the case file will be unable to be finished, whoever is dealing with it I m afraid

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: Would you say i’ve been safeguarded by you

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: You can form a defence from that

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: I am saying you are corrupt

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: Therefore you are now my suspect

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: And the file is my evidence

entries.speaker: PC Dixon
entries.quote: Ben, as I have said we can speak on the phone or arrange to speak if you would like a proper conversation. I am currently dealing with a prisoner in custody and also have 41 cases to look at. I am happy to discuss with you but typing on messages is not a fluid conversation

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: Didnt log my suicide and left no safeguarding

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: Not perverting the course of justice??

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: And can mention it in court

entries.speaker: Ben Carter
entries.quote: You do not have my cincent to “finsh my file”
